name: Gosei Sentai Dairanger
description: The three Tribes of the Daos Empire - Shura, Dai and Gorma - were peaceful until the Gorma set out to conquer the planet, launching a magical war between the Gorma and Dai Tribes that lasted for centuries. In the end, both civilizations were lost... until now. The evil Gorma have returned. Now, it's up to Master Kaku to assemble a team of kids with high levels of Ch'i to become the protectors of the Earth known as the Dairangers!

videos.title: Transform
videos.overview: Ryo, a simple restaurant worker, is brought in as one of five manipulators to become the Dairanger under Master Kaku to face the revival of the Gorma Tribe.

videos.title: It's Ch'i Power!!
videos.overview: Shoji tries to redeem himself after he fails to stop a boy from being abducted for a Gorma sacrifice ceremony.

videos.title: Your Souls, Please!
videos.overview: Daigo is brought in to help Shoji and Kazu affter a girl accuses them of hurting her little brother attacked by a Gorma Minion.

videos.title: We Were Naive!!
videos.overview: Angered by the Dairangers' lack of confidence in each other in dealing with the Key Jester, Master Kaku forces the team to learn a history lesson regarding the Gorma and the consequences of their failure.

videos.title: The Jewels Have Come
videos.overview: Lin feels regret in holding the team back when troubles dealing with a Gorma Minion escalate due to it seeing her as its target.

videos.title: Break Through the Wind
videos.overview: Having been mysteriously teleported to the Daos Civilization ruins in China, Rin tries to discover the location of the qi-power Lailai Jewels with a revenge-driven Lipstick Songstress in pursuit.

videos.title: Traitor!
videos.overview: A higher-ranked Gorma sends out a powerful warrior who can control both qi and you-energy and whom Kaku does not wish Ryo to encounter.

videos.title: Father!!
videos.overview: Shocked by the revelation Zhang Liao is his father, Ryo tries to figure how a traitor could be connected to him as Archbishop Saw takes matters into his own hands.

videos.title: Don't Be Vain
videos.overview: Daigo is approached by the vision of a peacock and a mysterious qi to defeat a Gorma Minion which had trapped within an ancient Dai warrior.

videos.title: Ah, the Vengeful Goddess
videos.overview: Kujaku's peaceful ways become inflamed when she decides to pursue Gara for her six-thousand years of grief, troubling Daigo.

videos.title: Gauss with a Magnet!
videos.overview: Shoji's problems in winning the heart of a girl are complicated by a magnet Gorma Minion making them repel one another.

videos.title: Drunk on Tofu
videos.overview: Kazu stands against a tofu Gorma Minion making everyone drunk, including Daigo and Shoji.

videos.title: The Ka-Kabuki Novice
videos.overview: The Dairanger deal with a Gorma Minion possessing people into being kabuki actors, all while dealing with an arrival from China Lin must cope with.

videos.title: Well, a Wedding
videos.overview: Lin assists her grandfather Yufang in taking down Kabuki Novice in order to save his bride-to-be from the Gorma.

videos.title: The 3 Stooges' Soccer
videos.overview: When his sister is abducted by a trio of weird Gorma Minions, Ryo must face them in a game of soccer in order to get her back.

videos.title: Rumbling Child Stones
videos.overview: As the Dairanger investigate children being turned into stone, Kujaku manipulates the scenario for another chance at Gara while Daigo tries to reopen her kind heart.

videos.title: He's Here, a New Hero
videos.overview: A wild, bratty boy is summoned by a mysterious voice to gain the power to become the sixth Dairanger as the Gorma forces gain a new leader in the form of Shadam's son.

videos.title: The Secret Byakko-chan
videos.overview: Kou becomes a hindrance instead of help as Kibaranger as he abuses his new powers and decides to move in with Lin to learn more from the team without revealing himself

videos.title: The Heart-Throbbing Pretty Girl
videos.overview: Kou befriends a girl whose parental relations make him question his own and fall into a plot by Akomaru to grow hatred within him.

videos.title: First Opening of the Gorma Palace
videos.overview: As Akomaru continues to seed mistrust in Kou's relations with his mother, Shadam tries to prove his continued necessity in leading the forces to the Gorma emperor.

videos.title: The Birth of a Mythical Ch'i Beast
videos.overview: As the Dairanger are asked to assist in the arrival of a sixth Qi Beast, Shadam makes his move in abducting Ryo to prevent this from happening.

videos.title: The Great Secret Art of the Tiger Cub!!
videos.overview: As the Dairanger work to bring to life the sixth Qi Beast, Akomaru confronts Kou one final time to reveal the fate of his missing mother.

videos.title: True Love at Full Speed
videos.overview: Daigo's love of Kujaku causes further problems for the Dairanger when she reappears in order to manage Gara without their assistance

videos.title: The 3 Stooges' Super Baseball!
videos.overview: Shoji takes up an offer of the Gorma Stooges to play them in a game of baseball, believing it will help them escape from the Gorma's service.

videos.title: The Grouped Opposite Squadron
videos.overview: Kazu is captured and replaced with a Gorma Minion's copy in an attempt to eliminate Master Kaku by infiltrating the team.

videos.title: A Bad, Bad, Bad Guy
videos.overview: Ryo becomes befuddled in trying to take down a powerful dojo destroyer while the Dairanger are forced to face a Gorma Minion who absorbs all their blows.

videos.title: It It It's the Final Punch
videos.overview: Ryo undergoes special training in order to gain the speed needed to both take down Jin Matoba and save his teammates from the resilient Pot Taoist.

videos.title: Everyone Appears!!
videos.overview: The Dairanger are distracted by various allies and enemies by the Gorma Emperor's personal warriors while the Triumvirate pursue an artifact found by a turtle-obsessed man.

videos.title: The Secret Inside Story of a Mother and Child's Tears
videos.overview: When the Dairanger learn the truth regarding Kou and Kibaranger, they likewise gain a dire warning from his mother about his parentage and a countdown towards a shifted alliance for him.

videos.title: The Deadly, Fast-Talking Workaholic
videos.overview: The Dairanger must save Kou and other children abducted to provide the Gorma Triumvirate the spiritual powers of hell while reclaiming their weapons from Fast-Talking Wanderer  for their new trump card.

videos.title: Again, a New Hero Came Forth
videos.overview: Kazu becomes trapped by a curse of the Gorma Four Devas, forcing Kameo to stand up and embrace his true destiny in order to save him.

videos.title: The Ogre's Golden Kick
videos.overview: Shoji's improper usage of his Aura Changer communicator nearly gets him and Ryo in trouble when he's captured by a banished Gorma Minion trying to reclaim his ultimate weapon.

videos.title: An Idol's First Experience
videos.overview: Lin falls for a mysterious man who makes her famous, without revealing the truth behind his darker intentions for her sudden rise to fame.

videos.title: A Prickly Maiden Hunt
videos.overview: Daigo becomes involved with a Gorma Minion abducting young girls when he discovers its connection with a mystery girl and a cactus he cared for.

videos.title: New Secret Art, the Dance of Spiders
videos.overview: Ryo becomes subject to Jin's newly mastered technique, which could kill him if he doesn't discover the method for defeating its power.

videos.title: A 6000-Year Grudge...
videos.overview: Daigo and the Dairanger are lured to the location where the Sacred Peacock's Tear may be found for Kujaku, only to learn more about the truth between her and Gara.

videos.title: You Have to See It!! A Huge Guy
videos.overview: As both Akomaru and Shadam position to manipulate Kou's you-energy to make him a Gorma, the sighting and arrival of a massive dragon foretells of an even greater calamity.

videos.title: Huh!! A Ceasefire!?
videos.overview: Daijinryuu begins to destroy the world due to the war of the Dairanger and Gorma, forcing Kaku to confront the Gorma emperor on an extreme measure for stopping the judgement.

videos.title: The Demon Fist Falls in the Setting Sun
videos.overview: Ryo looks after Jin after he escapes Zydos' grasp, only to become bonded to a promise to save his ultimate rival before he becomes a monster.

videos.title: Farewell! 3 Stooges
videos.overview: The Gorma Stooges challenge Shoji once again, leading to a climactic bike race where they must weigh whether they are meant to be eternal losers.

videos.title: Kujaku's Great Ascension
videos.overview: As Daigo and Kujaku finally discover the location of the Sacred Peacock Tear, they must weight whether the Peacock Buddha can be saved as Gara unleashes her ultimate wrath upon her.

videos.title: A Straight Line To Mommy
videos.overview: Lin finally discovers Kou's mother being held by Akomaru, even as the Gorma child prepares for KibaRanger's Gorma ascension and both Shadam and Daijinryuu get in their way.

videos.title: The Ultra-White Prohibited Past
videos.overview: As Kou's birthday approaches and Daijinryuu ups the stakes, Kaku takes matters into his own hands as Akomaru prepares to go all out for a personal victory.

videos.title: Impression!! You Cry Too
videos.overview: The Dairangers must stand up to Akomaru, Ikazuchi and even Kou himself in order for his mother to finally save him, as the truth regarding KibaRanger and Akomaru is finally revealed!

videos.title: Disbanding for Real!!
videos.overview: Kaku, finally returned to his true position, forces the Dairanger to disband as part of a condition to end the ancient war; but the team suspect more may be going on.

videos.title: The Heroes Are Stark Naked
videos.overview: When the Dairanger continue to interfere with Kaku's ultimate plan, the former mentor gives them a final ultimatum: surrender their powers or face the consequences.

videos.title: The Amazing Truth
videos.overview: As the Dairanger return to their normal lives, they're reminded of what they've gone through and who they are as Kaku prepares to fight to become the next Gorma Emperor.

videos.title: Death of the Heroic Master!!
videos.overview: Even without their powers, the Dairanger continue to hold off Zydos to protect Master Kaku's towers as he faces his showdown with Shadam for the right to be emperor of the Gorma.

videos.title: It's the Final Decisive Battle
videos.overview: The Dairanger storm into the Gorma Palace in order to take down their eternal enemy, unknowing of the horrifying extent of Shadam's control of events.

videos.title: Let's Go!
videos.overview: The Dairanger face off with Shadam for the final time, yet even with the Gorma war at a climax, they find out a final lesson from Kaku that may reveal a truth regarding all that happened.
